children.name: wifi
children.label: Wi-Fi
children.cmd: sh -c 'if [ "$VAL" = 1 ]; then nmcli radio wifi on; else nmcli radio wifi off; fi'
children.read_cmd: nmcli radio wifi | grep -q enabled && echo 1 || echo 0

children.name: bluetooth
children.label: Bluetooth
children.cmd: sh -c 'if [ "$VAL" = 1 ]; then bluetoothctl power on; else bluetoothctl power off; fi'
children.read_cmd: bluetoothctl show | grep -q 'Powered: yes' && echo 1 || echo 0

children.name: dnd
children.label: Do Not Disturb
children.cmd: sh -c 'if [ "$VAL" = 1 ]; then makoctl mode -a dnd; else makoctl mode -r dnd; fi'

children.name: idle
children.label: Screen Lock
children.cmd: sh -c 'if [ "$VAL" = 1 ]; then pidof swayidle || swayidle &; else pkill swayidle; fi'
